rationale: The oracle is valid and intentionally stricter than contract readiness. Current evidence proves the pinned local Hindsight container is running, healthy, database-connected, and localhost-only. The strict preflight is blocked solely because live env values are absent. T002 may generate ephemeral local-only credentials and a unique sacrificial bank id in memory, execute reviewed-plan live fixtures, retain evidence only under ignored tmp/, and stop on any non-local target, partial failure, redaction failure, or ambiguous bank isolation.

worker_package.objective: Bring the pinned local Hindsight runtime to strict-ready state and execute the governed live smoke against a uniquely named sacrificial local bank.
stop_if: The resolved endpoint is not local.
The target bank cannot be proven sacrificial.
A real external credential is required but unavailable.
Any output exposes a credential or unredacted sensitive content.

evidence: Preflight 2026-07-17T16:20:16.693Z: endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8888 healthy with database connected.
Docker container supermemory-hindsight-local is running with 8888 and 9999 bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
Compose resolves the immutable pinned Hindsight digest.
Live environment statuses are all not_set; no credential values were read or printed.
Current release and test receipts prove contract-ready but do not prove runtime-ready.
missing_evidence: Explicit post-evidence production approval and production decision report.
required_board_updates: Mark T001 done and activate T002.
